message.content:
**Paris Get‑away Plan (10 days)**  
*(Adjust dates and budget to fit your schedule and preferences.)*

| Day | Time | Activity | Notes |
|-----|------|----------|-------|
| **Day 1 – Arrival** | Morning | Fly into Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). | Book a direct flight if possible; otherwise a short layover. |
| | Afternoon | Check‑in at a boutique hotel in Le Marais (e.g., Hôtel Caron de Beaumarchais) or a centrally located Airbnb. | 2‑3 star hotels cost €120–€200/night. |
| | Evening | Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (classic French cuisine). | Reserve a table; try coq au vin. |
| **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | 9 am | Visit the Louvre. | Arrive early to avoid crowds; buy a skip‑the‑line ticket (€17). |
| | 12 pm | Lunch at **Café Marly** overlooking the Louvre’s courtyard. | |
| | 2 pm | Walk to Notre‑Dame & Sainte‑Chapelle. | Sainte‑Chapelle tickets €11. |
| | 5 pm | Stroll along the Seine, cross Pont des Arts. | |
| | 7 pm | Dinner at **Le Procope** (oldest café in Paris). | |
| **Day 3 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur** | 10 am | Explore Montmartre: Place du Tertre, artists’ square. | |
| | 12 pm | Lunch at **La Maison Rose**. | |
| | 2 pm | Visit Sacré‑Coeur Basilica. | Free entry; panoramic view of Paris. |
| | 5 pm | Sunset from the steps of Sacré‑Coeur. | |
| | 8 pm | Dinner at **Le Consulat** (historic bistro). | |
| **Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles** | 8 am | Take RER C train to Versailles Château. | Train fare €7.30 each way. |
| | 9 am | Tour the Palace, Hall of Mirrors, and Gardens. | Skip‑the‑line ticket €20. |
| | 1 pm | Picnic lunch in the gardens (buy baguette, cheese, wine). | |
| | 4 pm | Return to Paris. | |
| | 7 pm | Dinner at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (Michelin‑starred). | Reservations needed; budget €80+. |
| **Day 5 – Art & Culture** | 10 am | Visit Musée d’Orsay (Impressionist masterpieces). | Ticket €14. |
| | 12 pm | Lunch at **Le Café Marly** (again, but different view). | |
| | 2 pm | Explore the Latin Quarter: Sorbonne, Luxembourg Gardens. | |
| | 5 pm | Coffee break at **Café de Flore**. | |
| | 7 pm | Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (famous steakhouse). | |
| **Day 6 – Shopping & Fashion** | 10 am | Walk along Rue Saint‑Honoré & Avenue Montaigne (designer boutiques). | |
| | 12 pm | Lunch at **L’Avenue** (famous for celebrity clientele). | |
| | 2 pm | Visit Galeries Lafayette & Printemps for high‑end shopping. | |
| | 5 pm | Window‑shop at Le Bon Marché (luxury department store). | |
| | 7 pm | Dinner at **Le Cinq** (three Michelin stars). | Budget €150+. |
| **Day 7 – Relaxation & Spa** | 10 am | Book a spa day at **Spa Nuxe** or **Les Bains du Marais**. | |
| | 1 pm | Light lunch at **Le Petit Cler** (market street). | |
| | 3 pm | Leisure walk along Canal Saint‑Martin. | |
| | 6 pm | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches). | Ticket €15. |
| | 8 pm | Dinner at **Septime** (modern French). | Reservations required; budget €70+. |
| **Day 8 – Hidden Gems** | 10 am | Explore the covered passages: Passage des Panoramas, Passage Jouffroy. | |
| | 12 pm | Lunch at **Le Comptoir du Relais**. | |
| | 2 pm | Visit the Musée Rodin. | Ticket €13. |
| | 5 pm | Coffee at **Café Kitsuné** (in Palais Royal). | |
| | 7 pm | Dinner at **Frenchie** (small, trendy spot). | Reservations needed; budget €60+. |
| **Day 9 – Day Trip to Giverny** | 8 am | Take a train to Vernon, then a bus to Giverny. | Train + bus €12. |
| | 9 am | Tour Monet’s house & gardens. | Ticket €12. |
| | 12 pm | Picnic lunch in the gardens. | |
| | 3 pm | Return to Paris. | |
| | 7 pm | Farewell dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower). | Reservations needed; budget €200+. |
| **Day 10 – Departure** | Morning | Last‑minute souvenir shopping (lavender, macarons). | |
| | Noon | Check‑out & head to airport. | |

---

### Transportation Tips

| Mode | How to Use | Cost (per person) |
|------|------------|-------------------|
| Metro | Unlimited 10‑ticket pass (carnet) €16.90 | |
| RER | For day trips (Versailles, Giverny) | €7–€12 per trip |
| Taxi/Uber | For airport transfers | €35–€50 |
| Bicycle | Rent a Vélib' bike | €1.75 per hour |

### Budget Overview (per person)

| Category | Approx. Cost |
|----------|--------------|
| Flights | €400–€800 (depending on origin) |
| Accommodation | €1,200–€2,000 (10 nights) |
| Food & Dining | €600–€1,200 |
| Attractions & Tours | €300–€500 |
| Transportation | €150–€250 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €200–€400 |
| **Total** | **€2,850–€5,050** |

*(Prices are estimates; adjust based on your travel style.)*

---

### Packing Checklist

- Comfortable walking shoes (Paris streets can be uneven).
- Light jacket or scarf (even in summer, evenings can be cool).
- Power adapter (France uses Type C & E plugs, 230 V).
- Reusable water bottle (many cafés offer free refills).
- Small daypack for daily excursions.

---

### Quick Reference

- **Currency:** Euro (€). Credit cards accepted everywhere; carry some cash for small cafés.
- **Language:** French is official; English is widely understood in tourist areas.
- **Safety:** Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded places; use a money belt.
- **Health:** No special vaccinations required; standard travel insurance recommended.

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like a more tailored itinerary (e.g., specific dates, budget constraints, dietary restrictions), just let me know.
